review:
Dragon Tribe is a 6x4 fantasy slot that pairs xWays and xNudge. xWays mystery symbols hold up to three symbols and extend reel height for up to 20,736 ways, while xNudge Wilds drop to the bottom of their reel, adding up to x6, before expanding to cover it.

Its free spins come in two versions: standard Dragon Spins with xNudge Wilds, and Dragon Spins Extreme with both xNudge and xWays. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 27,000x cap.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
